application.reason: High-quality tree shadows and balanced hemisphere fill already provide broad ground-value variation. No moving cloud/tree shadow map or Low/mobile realtime shading guarantee is claimed.

notes.text: Maintain a restrained base palette, allowing signs, flowers, warning panels, vehicles and occasional ornamental foliage to supply smaller saturated accents.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Restrained base material families retain localized vehicle/sign/flower accents; arbitrary warning panels or purple ornamental plants are not added to unregistered sites.

notes.text: Vary window reflections by orientation and surrounding scene while preserving the repeatable rhythm of each frontage.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Orientation-dependent sky reflection and variable dark interior shading exist, but actual nearby-building reflection in windows is missing. The accepted lake-only object reflection pass does not close this glass-specific gap.

notes.text: Use changes in roof height, crown height and partial tree screening to create depth down a street.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Existing source building/crown envelopes and partial occlusion preserve depth without imposing one roof height or tree height on every block.

notes.text: Keep the scale of cracks, bricks, aggregate and leaves consistent with the car, curb and human-scale fixtures.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Metre-based grain/boards/mortar/leaf detail and human-scale existing fixtures provide scale consistency; inferred dimensions remain labeled, not photographic measurements.

notes.text: Represent bright water wakes, small wind ripples and slower shore reflections as different visual layers with different extents.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Filtered wind ripples and bounded High-desktop shore reflections are implemented as separate layers; moving-boat wakes and foam remain absent, so this combined recommendation is only partially represented. Shore reflections can pause during a legitimate performance-budget cooldown while sky/environment water remains.

notes.text: Reduce fine texture contrast with viewing distance so distant pavement and foliage do not shimmer or turn into a noisy pattern.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Fine detail uses continuous metre derivatives and footprint fades. The accepted terrain and foliage refinements reduce filtering artifacts and shimmer. Paired browser review and all 16 benchmark checks passed for this release; those measured configurations do not establish performance on every physical device.

notes.text: Retain exposed soil and litter beneath the tree clusters supported by venue and woodland-floor references.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Registered Ranch soil/hardpad/gravel and source forest-floor classes retain exposed ground where supported. This does not infer blanket bare soil beneath every tree.

notes.text: Treat workers, cones, temporary event furnishings and parked vehicle arrangements as dated scene states.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Existing berth/camp/parking interpretations declare authored or dated context. The game does not present the photographed temporary workers/cones/event inventory as permanent geography.

notes.text: Join paving patches with coherent material boundaries and continuous contact with adjacent ground.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Grounded feature clipping, pad coverage and retained actual terrain support keep existing patches in contact. Unregistered property stair/wall joins remain unresolved.

notes.text: Give each road type a recognizable balance of curb, shoulder, sidewalk, planting and overhead equipment; the references show several different balances.
notes.part: Light, water, material families and visual depth
notes.section: Art recommendations derived from the visual comparisons

application.reason: Existing road/shoulder/sidewalk source families and packet-supported equipment preserve different corridor balances. No exact current roadside fixture inventory is implied.
